name: gap_and_go_with_volume_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Stocks that gap up/down AND show > 3x normal volume in the first 5 minutes are experiencing genuine institutional interest, not just noise. When these stocks pull back to VWAP within the first 30 minutes and bounce, the continuation is highly reliable because the volume signature confirms real demand/supply. Edge persists because combining gap + volume + VWAP pullback is a 3-factor setup that most single-factor gap traders miss.
stock_filter: any FnO stock that gaps > 0.5% with > 3x volume in first 5 min

indicators.name: vwap_touch
indicators.formula: abs(low - vwap) / vwap < 0.001 (for gap up) OR abs(high - vwap) / vwap < 0.001 (for gap down)

conditions: vwap_touch == True (price pulled back to VWAP)
long.confirmation: bar closes above VWAP after touching it

short.confirmation: bar closes below VWAP after touching it

exit.target: high_of_day (for longs) or low_of_day (for shorts) — retest the extreme
exit.stop_loss: 0.3% below VWAP (for longs) or above VWAP (for shorts)

filters.trend_filter: gap direction aligns with nifty50 direction

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — gap + volume + VWAP is a multi-factor setup that's harder to crowd

weaknesses: VWAP pullback may not happen if gap momentum is too strong — missed entries
Opening 30 min spreads and slippage are elevated (4+ bps)
The 3x volume threshold is arbitrary — needs calibration per stock
prior_art: Gap and Go (Andrew Aziz, Warrior Trading) — adapted with VWAP pullback confirmation for Indian markets
notes: This is one of the higher-conviction setups due to multi-factor confirmation. Prioritize in backtesting.
